tools.name: list_calculators
tools.description: List available calculators, optionally filtered by category

tools.name: get_calculator_schema
tools.description: Get the input schema for a specific calculator

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Run a calculation and get results + prefilled URL

strict.description: If true, reject invalid or unknown input fields instead of dropping them

tools.name: generate_prefilled_url
tools.description: Generate a prefilled URL without running calculation

strict.description: If true, reject invalid or unknown input fields instead of dropping them

tools.name: calculate_cas
tools.description: Evaluate one or more headless CAS expressions server-side (MCP-only numeric mode). Unsupported expressions return a GUI handoff link.

expressions.description: Optional ordered list of CAS expressions to evaluate in one isolated context (supports assignments across the batch)

strict.description: If true, reject unknown fields and malformed expressions instead of dropping them

tools.name: calculate_cas_headless
tools.description: Alias of calculate_cas. Headless MCP-only CAS evaluator; if unsupported features are requested, returns GUI handoff details.

expressions.description: Optional ordered list of CAS expressions to evaluate in one isolated context (supports assignments across the batch)

strict.description: If true, reject unknown fields and malformed expressions instead of dropping them

tools.name: create_session
tools.description: Create a new interactive session for any calculator and return the session URL

tools.name: get_session_state
tools.description: Retrieve the current field values, computation transcript, and pending message queue for an active session

tools.name: push_session_action
tools.description: Push actions into a session's message queue (set fields, submit computation, trigger plot, etc.)

actions.description: Array of SessionAction objects to push to the browser

items.description: A session action. Supports CAS actions, form field updates, and spreadsheet actions like set_cells/get_cells/load_csv/export_csv/set_column_format.

expression.description: Math expression (for submit_expression and plot actions)

fields.description: Key-value pairs of field names to values (for set_fields action on form calculators)

cells.description: Cell raw values keyed by A1 refs (for set_cells on spreadsheet)

ranges.description: A1 ranges or single refs (for get_cells and clear_cells)

target.description: Target cell for load_csv (defaults to A1)

formats.description: Column display formats keyed by column letter (for set_column_format)

markdown.description: Markdown text for a static commentary block (links/code are sanitized)

range.description: Plot range as [min, max] for 'plot', or A1 range string for 'export_csv'

key.description: Single RPN key or token (for rpn_keypress)

keys.description: Ordered list of RPN keys or commands (for rpn_key_sequence)

registers.description: Register map for RPN memory updates

preservePrograms.description: Preserve stored RPN programs when resetting

id.description: Proof line id for update/delete/move/indent actions

patch.description: Proof line patch payload for proof_update_line. Include fields like source, justification, indent, or tags.

source.description: Proof line content to display in the builder

justification.description: Optional justification text for the proof line

indent.description: Indent level for the proof line

line.description: Optional line payload for proof_insert_line. Include source and optional justification/indent/tags.

justification.description: Optional justification for the inserted proof line

indent.description: Indent level for the inserted proof line

document.description: Full proof document payload for proof_replace_document

tools.name: close_session
tools.description: Close a session and optionally persist a snapshot of its final state
